fix(trends): require full-series comparability for score deltas

The score-delta comparability check only compared the first and latest
scored artifacts, so a mid-series catalog or context drift still
produced a numeric delta spanning a comparability break. Restore the
full-series rule (every scored artifact must share catalog version and
context hash) and add mid-series drift regression tests.

fix(runtime): reserve the final audit-loop step for terminal transitions

A loop could burn its 128-step budget while still active (lease cycles,
retries, proposal rounds) and thereafter record no transition at all —
not even deadline-expired — leaving require_terminal sealing blocked
forever. Non-terminal transitions are now refused once 127 steps exist;
after the deadline any action records the forced deadline-exhaustion
step, so every loop remains sealable. Full-length chains that do not end
in a terminal state are rejected on read.

Also harden step validation: a converged re-audit must carry DONE status
and SCORED score_state (matching the schema guard instead of relying on
the artifact validator implicitly), and state_retries is bounded by the
loop's own max_retries rather than the global retry cap. Replace the
pinned 3.0/3.0.0 auditIdentity consts with format patterns so the schema
does not go stale on version bumps.

fix(runtime): report budget exhaustion as budget-exhausted closure failure

Step/byte budget exhaustion during loop-closure verification was mapped
to validator-error, mislabeling a resource limit as a validation
failure. Add a dedicated budget-exhausted failure code to the envelope
schema enums and the closure code set, and map budget/limit messages to
it.

fix(guards): scope dependency-tree exclusion and assert uniqueness

The node_modules markdown-guard exclusion was global, so any second
dependency tree would silently escape the architecture and local-link
guards. Exclusions now apply only beneath declared isolated trees
(evals/pi-agent-poc), and a new check_isolated_dependency_trees guard
fails on any package.json outside the declared set.

test(evals): widen Pi probe observation to sync subprocess and dns/tls

The network-observation preload hooked only async child_process variants
and http/https/net, leaving execSync/execFileSync/spawnSync, dns, tls,
dgram, and worker_threads unobserved while the test name claimed no
network or subprocess invocation. Hook those surfaces too and update the
README coverage description.
